notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Derevi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing Derevi with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat.
